item.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合架构开源模型（全局注意力层+有界状态层）缓存异构，需求随上下文长度与并发变化，GPU 显存分配与驻留管理困难。

方法：TideCache 三组件：Transparent Cache Pool 在固定虚拟地址后重分布物理页、保持缓存布局与后端接口；Cache Streamer 利用有界状态层计算间隔预取下一全局注意力层前缀；Request Scheduler 按请求大小与队列状态选择驻留或流式执行并触发容量调整。

关键数字：GB300/GH200 七种模型/平台配置上，相对 SGLang+HiCache 完成的 agent turns 最多 2.04×，P50 per-token 延迟降 20–59%，agent P50 TTFT 改善 1.40–3.05×。

为什么值得看：层间流式重叠把释放的 HBM 用于更多请求，混合架构 serving 的实用方案。

item.title: Thinflow: Organizing HPC Benchmarking Campaigns as Rerunnable Directory Trees
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：HPC 基准测试活动迁移到另一台超算或数月后重跑，需要大量非研究本身的适配工作（作业脚本、重建"当时到底跑了什么"）。

方法：Thinflow 是小型 Bash 引擎，把测试活动组织成可重跑的目录树：任务=目录+短 shell 脚本；从声明依赖推导执行顺序写入明文 manifest；每超算 profile 提交；每次运行记录环境/硬件/参数 provenance；引擎随活动目录分发。

关键数字：案例研究在 2 台超算 3 个 Slurm 分区最多 16 节点运行同一套任务文件：37 个任务文件共 217 行非注释代码、455 次基准运行。

为什么值得看：极简结构让 HPC 基准活动可重跑、可作论文 artifact。

item.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State

Over the past three centuries, many thermodynamics researchers have worked to develop fluid equations of state with both high accuracy and broad applicability, proposing various theoretical frameworks and models. Building on these efforts, this study uses Gibbs free energy as the starting point and introduces thermodynamically consistent neural networks to construct a fluid equation of state based on Gibbs free energy (GEoS). This approach establishes a novel machine learning framework that provides a unified representation of fluid states. GEoS performs well on the vapor- and liquid-phase density test sets, with average absolute relative deviations (AARDs) of 5.25% and 3.96%, respectively. It outperforms conventional volume-translated cubic equations of state and existing machine learning models, demonstrating its effectiveness. Further analysis using the UMAP dimensionality reduction method shows that most molecules in the test set belong to extrapolation systems, confirming the strong generalization ability of the model. Finally, the test results show that the PC-SAFT equation fitted using GEoS maintains high predictive accuracy, providing a reliable basis for its practical appl…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Tenon: A Unified Programming Framework for Retargetable PIM Compilation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：各类 PIM 器件编程栈碎片化（指令序列到类 C 语言不一），且紧耦合的计算-存储使数据布局成为一等优化目标，现有 PIM 编译器缺乏统一表示。

方法：Tenon 把 PIM 编译目标建模为计算/存储单元嵌套网格加合法数据传输路径；将 GPU 编译器的 F2 线性布局代数推广到 PIM，按负载与目标规格自动构造最小移动数据布局。

关键数字：6 个 PIM 后端（5 个商用 + AttAcc），商用后端匹配或超越厂商/专家/编译器基线，几何平均提速最高 1.20×、单项最高 3.65×；GPT-13B 解码在 AttAcc 上比 SOTA PIM 编译器 DCC 快 1.2–1.3%。

为什么值得看：负载一次表达、跨 PIM 目标族可移植编译，性能可移植性好。

item.title: StarMPI-SVD: Distributed-Memory Parallel Star-M Tensor SVD
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：star-M 张量代数把矩阵 SVD 的最优压缩保证推广到高阶张量，但 t-SVDM-I/II 仅有共享内存实现，无法处理现代大规模数据集。

方法：首个分布式内存 t-SVDM-I 与 t-SVDM-II 实现，推广到 N 维张量；针对计算与通信瓶颈设计异步、非阻塞通信策略做高效数据重分布。

关键数字：强扩展实验最多 128 节点（6144 核）并行效率不低于 70%；对最大 768GB 的应用数据集应用 star-M 压缩。

为什么值得看：把张量 SVD 压缩能力带到分布式内存规模。

item.title: Splice-Core: Low-Order-Bit-Splicing GEMM for Highly Energy-Efficient AI Inference Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 推理加速器中低阶位累加延迟大，且高阶激活位适合值依赖执行，二者难以兼得。

方法：Splice-Core 是 temporal-unary/binary（tub）混合 GEMM 单元，最小化低阶位累加延迟、保留高阶位值依赖执行；含 Splice-BP（位平面）与 Splice-LUT（单周期选择共享权重倍数）两种 PE。

关键数字：45nm 下 26 个 INT4 CNN/LLM 负载，Splice-BP/Splice-LUT 相对二值脉动阵列 tile 能耗几何平均降 77.4%/76.4%；Splice-LUT 吞吐提升 44.4%、EDP 降 6.13×；W8A8 负载 tile 能耗降 77.3–88.1%；布局布线后面积小 14%/9%。

为什么值得看：低阶位拼接策略兼顾能耗与吞吐，INT4/W8A8 场景收益显著。

item.title: Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications

Programs increasingly call large language models (LLMs), filling prompt placeholders with program values and consuming the output. Such a call crosses the boundary between natural language and programming language (NL/PL). To follow data across it, an analysis needs a data-flow summary of which placeholders the output uses, but no code describes what the model does. Analyses of these LLM-integrated applications therefore taint every output with every input, creating spurious flows, or ask a second model to label each call, which is costly. We prove, and mechanize in Lean 4, that a placeholder flows to the output of a transformer, to first order, only through the attention that reads it (no reading, no flow), and that a faint reading or sensitivity cannot certify that a placeholder does not flow. Unlike reading, the log-probability gradients and Fisher signals of existing methods vanish on confident outputs, and single-span removal fails on duplicated content. Our tool, Sightline, reads a recorded call in one forward pass, learns from labels which reads are uses, and calibrates the pruning to miss at most a chosen fraction $α$ of true flows, on average over call sites, when deployme…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment

Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model. Much of this cost is wasted: a fixed budget is applied to every prompt, although the computation required by prompts varies widely. Adaptive methods halt once sampled answers appear settled, but their thresholds are tuned heuristics with no statistical control over early-stopping errors. We instead seek an anytime-valid stopping rule that takes an error tolerance $α$ as input and halts only once an answer is certified to hold a majority ($θ_a > 1/2$) under the generator's distribution. We aggregate candidates by final answer with a reward-weighted self-consistency (RWSC) score and treat stopping as a sequential test over the resulting clusters. Applying Wald's sequential probability ratio test to these clusters yields SPRT-RWSC, which performs well empirically, but its guarantee fails because the leading answer shifts during sampling, and the run is continuously monitored. Our main contribution, e-RWSC, replaces Wald's test with a betting supermartingale (an e-process) for every answer the policy produc…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Scalable fault vulnerability analysis for ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：ReRAM 存内计算加速器对 stuck-at 永久故障敏感，故障注入评估大规模 CNN 脆弱性耗时数天甚至数周，计算开销难以承受。

方法：提出快速可扩展的解析框架，在权重、卷积核、层等多个粒度量化脆弱性分数（VS），无需穷举仿真，面向边缘与安全关键应用的容错加速器设计。

关键数字：相对穷举故障注入快约 10^4–10^5×，大规模 CNN 的脆弱性分析只需几分钟到几小时即可完成。

为什么值得看：把脆弱性评估从仿真密集转向解析计算，速度提升数个数量级。

item.title: SGLayout: Schema-Guided Closed-Loop Refinement for LLM-Driven Parameterized Layout Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

SGLayout: Schema-Guided Closed-Loop Refinement for LLM-Driven Parameterized Layout Generation

Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in parameterized layout generation via tool-augmented code synthesis. However, LLMs lack spatial awareness, making one-shot generation unreliable. While layout quality can be evaluated with established techniques, a critical gap remains: geometric-domain evaluation outcomes cannot be directly translated into actionable code-level fixes, trapping iterative refinement in blind refactoring. We propose SGLayout, a self-refining framework that closes this gap via a schema-guided mechanism. Upon code execution, a structured schema captures the correspondence between each code-level instance and its geometric attributes, establishing a bidirectional link between code space and geometry space. Emulating engineer review practices, SGLayout evaluates layouts along two complementary dimensions: intent compliance through quantitative structural checking and qualitative vision-language assessment, and rule compliance through DRC. All identified violations are then back-projected through the schema onto precise code targets, enabling surgical repair. This closed-loop process iterates until layout convergence. item.title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models

Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). Second, replacing router logits across all routed layers changes the judgment in all nine checkpoints, an…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). item.title: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching

Few-step diffusion models are widely deployed for their efficiency. However, reinforcing them with black-box rewards, as is routine for multi-step models, faces two structural challenges. First, a few-step generator is a sampler rather than a score model, so its velocity is not the forward velocity of the generated distribution. Second, it must be anchored to the undistilled teacher, which shares no transitions with it. Existing few-step RL methods handle the latter with a marginal KL to the teacher, but each pays for the former in its reward credit. We propose Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples into shadow inputs and obtains the credit from their shadow posterior. From the KL-regularized reward objective, we derive a regression loss that turns reward values into a reward direction while anchoring the generator's outputs to the teacher and aligning the shadow inputs with the deployed inputs. Applied to 4-step generators, SPM achieves higher rewards with less reward hacking than prior few-step RL methods.

item.title: ReLay: Bidirectional Layout-Code Translation and Library Evolution for Reusable and Process-Portable Analog Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

ReLay: Bidirectional Layout-Code Translation and Library Evolution for Reusable and Process-Portable Analog Design

Analog layout generators provide a programmable interface for design reuse and process migration, but their coverage is limited by handcrafted libraries. The designer knowledge embedded in complete layouts remains implicit in their geometry, making it difficult to capture in reusable generator libraries. We present ReLay, a bidirectional layout-code framework that recovers generator programs from existing layouts, enabling cross-PDK portability and parametric resizing of existing designs. Constructions that recur across recovered programs are promoted to library functions, so the library evolves as layouts accumulate. We also introduce the first layout-code benchmark: 1,050 hand-drawn layouts from 27 circuit families across three open-source PDKs, ranging from primitive cells to full chips. Learned functions account for 53-66% of layout-building calls in held-out layouts, demonstrating reuse beyond the learning corpus. Frontier LLM agents use ReLay to produce new layouts at 64-77% lower API cost per completed task than direct geometry generation, with comparable completion rates and electrical quality.

item.description:

研究问题：CAM 阵列可直接在存储内做相似性搜索，但传统读出只产生二值匹配结果，丢弃可进一步利用的定量相似度信息。

方法：RE-CAM 读出增强框架：复用比较器多次感知时变输出电压，联合优化参考电压、感知时间戳与解码参数，用一次 CAM 搜索近似线性和非线性函数。

关键数字：相对共享统一参考 ADC 基线，线性/分段线性/sigmoid/指数函数近似 NRMSE 降 10.89–24.34%（一般）、29.43–46.73%（利用数据分布）；搜索吞吐 8×、每次搜索能耗降 47%、面积降 39%。

为什么值得看：技术无关、应用无关的 CAM 定量搜索读出方案，低开销高吞吐。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Prescribed Bayesian Efficiency under Lifetime Adjustment Costs

A Bayesian learner may retain an issued action while updating its posterior, trading predictive loss against adjustment charges. We assume population curvature, boundary control, an order-$1/n$ lower bound on expected posterior uncertainty about the optimal action, and an observable unbiased gradient witness whose squared norms are uniformly integrable. Sample losses may be unbounded or nonconvex. Cumulative expected excess measures the loss increase relative to current predictive Bayes actions. For bounded nonnegative nondecreasing charges $c$ with $c(0)=0$ and nondecreasing profiles $G: \mathbb{N} \to [1,\infty)$ with $G(J)=o(J)$, we characterize joint attainability of cumulative expected excess $O(G(J))$ at horizons $T=2^J$ and finite expected lifetime charge. Here $J$ indexes logarithmic time. The criterion is finiteness of a prefix-constrained allocation of tracking-error allowances across action-distance scales, equivalently its decreasing-weight dual. Adaptive timing and private randomization do not enlarge the attainable region. item.title: Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices

In power setpoint tracking (PST), an operator follows a purchased charging profile without overloading shared transformers or undercharging vehicles. PST is cast as a constrained Markov decision process that minimizes tracking error subject to overload and mean user-satisfaction constraints. Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning (TC-CPL) extends soft actor-critic with proportional-integral Lagrange-multiplier updates from measured violations, a residual on the incumbent dispatcher that is warm-started from its demonstrations, and a transformer-aware encoder shared by all ports. It observes no departure times or states of charge. Simulations (five seeds, 100 paired days) compare it with the incumbent, Round-Robin. On a 600-port, 122-substation district, raw overload falls from 3.59 to 0.0017 kWh/day (overloaded seed-days from 77% to 0.4%), and absolute tracking error falls by 27%. Delivered energy rises by 16%, and satisfaction rises from 0.959 to 0.989. On a 42-kW transformer with household load, overload falls from 1.86 to 0.0014 kWh/day and satisfaction rises from 0.974 to 0.985, but absolute tracking error is 22% higher. item.title: PosteriorBench: Evaluating Behavior Posterior Sampling in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

PosteriorBench: Evaluating Behavior Posterior Sampling in Language Models

Rare language model behaviors can be difficult to study because obtaining them through ordinary sampling can require a very large number of samples. This motivates the behavior posterior sampling problem: given a language model and a behavior of interest, is there an algorithm that efficiently samples from the model's distribution over transcripts that exhibit this behavior? We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for comparing algorithms by their compute cost and by how close their samples are to the true posterior in forward and reverse KL divergence. PosteriorBench contains 21 tasks on Qwen3.5-0.8B with behavior probabilities from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-1}$, each with exact posterior samples from a corpus of one billion labeled responses. We find that no method we evaluate is both efficient and faithful: simple methods like prompting are cheap but plateau at a high KL divergence from the posterior, fine-tuning on posterior samples is often cost-prohibitive, and several training methods from prior work do not perform better. Building a posterior sampler that can cheaply approximate the true posterior remains an open problem, and we hope PosteriorBench can measure progress towards th…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Self-supervised Vision Backbones Survives Distribution Shift in Radar Micro-Doppler HAR

Micro-Doppler radar enables contactless, privacy-preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but deployment robustness remains underexplored. We compared full fine-tuning, frozen probing, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using subject-disjoint in-distribution cross-validation and few-shot cross-age, cross-orientation, and cross-dataset transfer. Full fine-tuning suffered negative cross-dataset transfer, while frozen features under-adapted on cross-orientation. Only PEFT avoided both failures. We paired DINOv3 with all-layer principal-singular-direction adaptation (PiSSA), to our knowledge the first application of a self-supervised image foundation backbone to radar micro-Doppler HAR. DINOv3-PiSSA ranked first among PEFT methods in every evaluated setting. Under our protocol, its Small variant matched the in-distribution accuracy of the prior Base-size PEFT state of the art using 4.5x fewer total parameters, with only 3% trainable. It surpassed a size-matched variant of that baseline in every evaluated setting, with transfer gains increasing with shift severity: 2.1, 6.6, and 8.9 percentage points, respectively. item.title: On the Informativeness of Structural Stability Bounds for GNNs: GINs versus GATs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

On the Informativeness of Structural Stability Bounds for GNNs: GINs versus GATs

Stability bounds for graph neural networks limit how much node representations can drift when the graph changes, but they are rarely compared with the simplest alternative: a bound on the distance between any two outputs, whatever the graph. We derive structural stability bounds for Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) and single-head GATv1 networks under deterministic edge perturbations that need not be small, and compare each with such a perturbation-independent diameter bound. For GINs, we characterize exactly when the stability bound is tighter, through a condition linking perturbation size, depth and maximum degree; it holds with a wide margin on Cora, but fails beyond a few layers on the low-degree MUTAG graphs. For GATv1, the bound is never tighter, which calls for analyses based on attention masses.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering

Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge. Large language models support automated modelling, but code syntax and successful execution alone do not establish whether generated models and results meet engineering requirements. We present OceanCoder, a Qwen3-8B-based large language model for automated simulation modelling in ocean engineering. To address specialised programming requirements and scarce training data, we develop an extensible data construction pipeline producing 12,000 verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples across 12 engineering task categories. A three-layer verification framework checks model inputs against engineering parameters and task constraints, verifies completion of required simulation analyses, and assesses the engineering plausibility of computed outputs. Its outcomes provide graded rewards for group relative policy optimisation (GRPO), guiding the model towards engineering task completion. We also construct the first benchmark for automated modelling in ocean engineering, covering out-of-distribution tasks and real-world engineering cases. item.description:

Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics

Data assimilation (DA) in partially observed nonlinear systems requires repeated estimation of both hidden states and their uncertainty. Conventional nonlinear filtering can be computationally expensive and often relies on an explicit dynamical model. In this paper, we develop the Neural Conditional Gaussian Model (Neural CGM), a data-driven dynamical model that maps unobserved physical states into a learned latent space, where the dynamics of the latent states follow a conditional Gaussian structure. This structure allows closed-form DA updates in the latent space, while nonlinear encoder-decoder mappings retain the flexibility needed to represent complex dynamics in physical space. A key feature of Neural CGM is its treatment of uncertainty in DA. The latent posterior mean and covariance are mapped to the physical variables through a Gaussian decoder that combines local moment propagation with learned nonlinear corrections. The resulting physical-space posterior statistics depend on the sequentially updated latent distribution rather than on a separate post-processing estimate. The same statistics enter a Gaussian negative log-likelihood during training, so both the posterior mea…

item.title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长程 agentic 任务需在 100K+ token 上下文中多步调用工具，而多数低比特量化按短文校准、以困惑度评判，与真实使用场景错位。

方法：NariQ 是一种 trellis-coded 训练后量化方法，用 BF16 模型在 agent 会话中生成的 token 进行校准，而非静态文本。

关键数字：Qwen3.8-27B 在 3.0 与 2.5 bit/weight 下，DeepSWE、Terminal Bench、AIME、RealWorldQA 均与 BF16 持平；而已有 ≤3bit 量化在 DeepSWE 上最多只解出 BF16 的 72% 任务；2.0 bit 检查点则落后。

为什么值得看：据作者称首个在 ≤3bit 下于长程 agentic 任务匹配全精度版本的量化，已发布 GGUF 与 llama.cpp fork。

NIMIS: A Structure-Agnostic, Chemically Informed Slot-Attention Framework for Demixing 1D $^1$H-NMR Mixture Spectra

The products of chemical reactions are usually complex mixtures that must be separated into their components before interpretable $^1$H-NMR spectra can be obtained. Direct analysis of the spectra of crude mixtures would accelerate reaction analysis and facilitate the exploration of new chemical space. We present NIMIS, a structure-agnostic, attention-based deep learning framework that groups the peaks of a 1D $^1$H-NMR mixture spectrum according to the component from which they originate. J-coupling information is introduced directly into the attention mechanism of a multi-head Transformer encoder, and the resulting contextualised peak embeddings are separated into components by slot attention. NIMIS was trained on 158,005 synthetic mixtures constructed from experimental spectra in the NMRexp database, covering molecules of up to 20 heavy atoms composed of C, H, N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I. On held-out molecules it reaches a peak-to-component assignment accuracy of 82.28% for noise-free input and 77.34% with 10% integral noise, with a mean NIMIS score of 0.83 for correct assignments. item.title: Mitigating Row Buffer Contention Through Multiple Row Buffer (MRB) DRAM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：DRAM bank 内只有单个共享行缓冲，不同核或访问模式对同一 bank 不同行的请求相互争用，造成行缓冲冲突的性能与能耗开销。

方法：提出多行缓冲（MRB）DRAM：每 bank 设一个主全局行缓冲外加多个二级 SRAM 行缓冲，作为缓存让 bank 并行服务多行请求。

关键数字：每 bank 4 个 SRB 时，相对传统 DDR4 基线单核系统性能平均提升 29.7%、多核系统 24%，面积开销仅约 2%。

为什么值得看：低面积开销缓解行缓冲争用，直接改善多核访存性能。

item.title: Matching Architecture to Workload: Comparing RISC-V Parallel Accelerators for Energy-Efficient Embedded Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：嵌入式负载计算特征差异大，选择执行模型（标量多核/流式多核/向量处理）需要量化理解各模型与负载类别的匹配。

方法：用三个开源 RISC-V 加速器作代表——PULP Cluster（标量多核）、Snitch Cluster（流式多核）、Spatz（向量处理），同 12nm 工艺、统一基准套件受控对比。

关键数字：Spatz 在规则高向量化负载最高 4.29× 性能、5.17× 能效；Snitch 在有限并行+流式访存负载 5.53× 性能、1.45× 能效；PULP 在不规则控制密集负载 5.66× 性能、2.80× 能效。

为什么值得看：无单一执行模型通吃，为嵌入式加速器选型提供同工艺量化依据。

item.title: MaskPE: One Mask, Two Roles: Weight Placement and MAC Gating in Systolic Arrays
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：非结构化剪枝减少权重存储，但在 weight-stationary 脉动阵列中不减少执行成本——压缩的非零权重需恢复到固定 PE 位置，零权重位置还须保持数据转发。

方法：MaskPE 是 mask 导向脉动架构：位置 mask 在 preload 阶段引导非零权重落位，执行阶段对零权重 PE 的算术寄存器做 clock-gating，降低动态功耗同时保持脉动数据流。

关键数字：50% 稀疏度下压缩权重存储减少 34.9%（含元数据开销）；RTL 验证精确执行、无额外稳态 tile stall；门级仿真显示 7 个 LLM 投影样本执行能耗降低 12.5–14.4%。

为什么值得看：让剪枝收益真正落到脉动阵列的执行与功耗上，一份 mask 两用。

item.title: Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields

Interpolating a spatial field, such as daily maximum temperature, from sparse, irregularly located observations recurs across the environmental and health sciences. Standard Gaussian-process kriging refits hyperparameters and solves an $O(N^3)$ system for every new field. When many related fields are observed, such as daily maps from one sensor network, neural processes (NPs) instead learn the interpolation map from past fields and predict a new field in one forward pass. Joint-predictive variants, which sample whole fields rather than independent per-location values, typically use self-attention over context and query points, costing $O(K^2)$ in the combined point count $K$ and limiting practical use to a few thousand points. State-space models offer a linear-time alternative, but a direct state-space adaptation compresses the context into one hidden state before reading queries, reducing what the decoder sees. We propose MambaFlowNP, a linear-compute joint-predictive NP trained with conditional flow matching. A multi-directional Mamba-2 scan reads context and query tokens in one shared sequence, so each query's velocity is read from its own scan position rather than a compressed …

item.title: Live Migration of Gated DeltaNet Requests: Exact Catch-Up and the Cost of Log Backlog
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：流式 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）请求的实时迁移，需要在相同权重的工作节点上于正确 token 边界恢复循环状态。

方法：适配快照、批量重放与 token catch-up，并设计紧凑 update-log 迁移路径；exact catch-up 保持原生单 token 解码、在测试输入上逐位匹配参考实现；用 prior-based 与 probe-calibrated 选择器按用户中断、源释放或输出率选择路径。

关键数字：1,350 次纯 GDN 试验 × 两个 GPU 部署：紧凑日志在全部 90 个配置中 handoff gap 最短；80 个完整配置里 exact catch-up 总是最早释放源；10 MB/s 时 32-step replay 把中位 gap 从 445–464ms 降至约 81ms；40 个历史 KV 对齐 Qwen 配置回顾性选择使平均 gap 降 13.9%。

为什么值得看：混合状态模型实时迁移的系统研究，量化精确追赶与日志积压的权衡。

item.title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Learning to Defer under Expert Drift

The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. This history-aware approach enables adaptive deferral policies that anticipate reliability fluctuations and better allocate decisions between human and machine over time. We provide comprehensive experiments across three diverse tasks -- image classification, medical diagnosis, and hate speech detection -- including generalization analyses under realistic deferral conditions and irregular…

item.title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions

Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values. A coordinate's own corrupted state can make prediction easy, potentially reducing the pressure to learn dependencies between coordinates. We study leave-one-out (LOO) prediction, in which each coordinate is predicted from the corrupted states of the other coordinates. We show that, under stated assumptions, jump diffusions with complete coordinate resets and state-independent clocks preserve the prescribed marginals when reset destinations use exact LOO probabilities and the drift uses the full endpoint posterior. We further show that this drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities by analytic likelihood completion without additional network evaluations. We evaluate unrestricted, LOO, and completed predictions on Text8 and LM1B text generation and ZINC250k molecular graph generation. LOO-based variants improve key generation metrics over matched unrestricted controls on all three datasets. Controlled interventions assess reliance on local inputs and context, and we analyze the …

item.title: Kameleo: In-Situ Activation-Precision Selection for Bit-Serial LLM Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：weight-only 量化把激活保持高精度，片上推理成本转移到激活算术；bit-serial 可变长度加速器按层选 mantissa 长度，但当前靠离线校准——每个模型/负载重复搜索，且在其他数据上静默退化。

方法：Kameleo 在加速器上运行时从处理中的数据选择激活精度：用局部代理比较每个 GEMM 在降精度与全精度下的输出；bit-serial 数据通路使降精度结果恰是全精度计算的中间态、几乎免费得到；对负载前若干 token 跑两遍即设定所有 GEMM 精度。

关键数字：4 个 LLM × 7 个数据集，1% 困惑度预算内 MXU prefill cycles 减少 2.11–2.34×，接近在评估数据上离线校准的配置；而校准配置迁移到其他数据常违反预算；选择硬件仅占加速器面积 3.7%。

为什么值得看：让可变长度 mantissa 在真实部署中可行，摆脱逐模型离线校准。

item.title: Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support

Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity scores to trajectories and an \emph{Explorer} that performs guided generation of high-scarcity and high-return trajectories, thereby bootstrapping from the narrow support with such self-generated trajectories. item.title: Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models

Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. Under a single Loewner comparison between the base statistic and the task curvatures, this control converts into a ceiling on the interference functional, inversely proportional to the penalty coefficient, so that the curvature term of the bound is controlled during training. item.title: How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?

Organizations monitor their workers' activity for insider threats, in which workers misuse their legitimate access, by copying confidential files before leaving. Detectors score how unusual each day of activity is, flagging the most unusual for an analyst to review. Prominent current approaches use opaque neural networks, so explanations of a flag point to internal features: patterns of neuron activity most active on days of misuse. We audit such explanations for language-model detectors trained on CERT's simulated workplace logs. To test an explanation, we see what happens to the detector's score when we remove its features inside the model. We compare this to a control: a change that is as similar as possible to the removal, but without actually removing the features. Because defining "similar" requires choosing a metric, our central contribution is the tipping radius: a first-order prediction of how far that metric must move before the difference between removal and control disappears, a measure of how fragile the result is to that choice. In 33 of 34 runs of seven language models, the tipping radius is at most 18% of the distance between two standard choices of metric. Moving t…

item.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 注意力用完整点积给每个 query 对每个 key 打分——这个点积必须算完吗？

方法：HiSA（Hidden Sparse Attention）保持 query/key 投影完整、只计算部分点积，按 token 位置确定的静态免参数规则在 hidden（特征）维度上做稀疏——比 token 稀疏更少被探索的轴；基于 RoPE 结构把 key/query 分解出可省略部分；从头训练 LLM，并扩展到 FlashAttention-3 内核。

关键数字：只计算约 1/3 的 query-key 乘积，性能不降反升；推理解码速度提升、内存占用缩小；代码开源。

为什么值得看：开辟 hidden 维度稀疏新轴，训练与推理双受益且无需学习参数。

item.title: Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes

LLM agents spend nearly all their time waiting for the model. On Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, our agents waited a median of 2.7 seconds for each model reply, then computed for an estimated 5 to 40 milliseconds. AgentCore does not charge for CPU during the wait. But it reserves a separate environment, a virtual machine with its own memory, for every conversation, and keeps it reserved until the conversation is closed. So 1,000 conversations reserve 1,000 environments to do the work of 2 to 15 processor cores. A service runs out of environments long before it runs out of processing power. The shortage has two causes, and each has a fix. An environment stays reserved after its conversation ends: in the customer-service benchmark we ran, a conversation lasts 33 seconds on average, but its environment is held for 15 minutes more unless the client closes it. And an environment serves only one conversation, which is mostly waiting: in our simulation, 64 conversations sharing one environment need 59 times fewer environments, and 99 of every 100 replies are delayed by at most 40 milliseconds. The milliseconds are an estimate because they are hard to measure: a stubbed model, a timer around the…

item.title: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models

Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM-Based RTL Repair
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 自动 RTL 修复在非局部故障（根因与失败输出在源码中相距很远）上表现挣扎；把 RTL 当扁平 token 序列会遮蔽硬件数据流，暴露完整综合图又让模型淹没在细粒度元数据里。

方法：GRODE-RTL 是 anchor-centric 表示：从网表提取嫌疑寄存器的单时钟级 fan-in cone，把网表节点映射回可编辑源码行，组织成紧凑的 hop 分区依赖视图；优先直接驱动、折叠远跳，引导标准 tool-using agent。

关键数字：30 个经正式验证的非局部故障 × 3 个 LLM，pass@1 相对源码级探索提升 DeepSeek 16.7%、GLM-5.2 26.7%、MiniMax-M3 20.0%；远距离与间接 anchor 子集一致增益；消融证明选择性依赖组织而非全图暴露是关键。

为什么值得看：给 LLM RTL 修复一个信息密度恰当的表示，非局部故障修复显著变好。

item.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合 LM 的循环层 in-place 状态更新把前缀复用限制在精确保存位置；粗网格保存浪费可复用前缀，细粒度精确缓存又须在中间 checkpoint 切断 prefill、增加调度开销。

方法：观察到多轮对话、agent 循环、文档问答与树搜索中前缀复用几乎总在可预测的结构边界（轮次结束、已知分支点）结束；FrontierReplay 在这些边界物化精确 checkpoint 而不切断 prefill——前向不截断时记录短窗口循环层输入，跨层 state-only replay 内核构建目标状态。

关键数字：replay 每 token 比完整重算便宜 6–37× 且无 host 同步；中位 TTFT 降 16–89%（最高 8.9×），80% SLO 容量最高提升 1.73×，goodput 最高提升 4.26×（大规模 3.67×）；相对近似 replay 方法 goodput 高至 1.54× 且保持精确任务准确率（近似方法长上下文最多掉 17% 准确率）。

为什么值得看：混合 LM 精确前缀缓存的优雅解法，免切断 prefill 且收益显著。

item.title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：提升乱序核性能同时满足 ASIC 面积/频率约束极为劳动密集，需要架构、RTL、性能分析多领域专家，小团队难以承担。

方法：MiracleGro 是 agentic 系统，无需人工干预即可分析 cycle-level RTL 行为与综合结果、识别性能瓶颈、把架构想法转成 BOOM（Berkeley Out-of-Order Machine）的 RTL 实现，并综合权衡 cycle-exact 性能、面积与关键路径。

关键数字：自动产出相比人工优化 BOOM 提升 85% IPC、SkyWater 130nm 频率提升 27% 的设计；完整 SPEC CPU2017 intspeed 墙钟时间加速 2.34×（30 万亿指令）。

为什么值得看：前沿模型端到端优化 RTL 处理平台，实现级微架构研究的范式转变。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Data Alignment to Parameter Generation: Few-Shot Cross-City Traffic Prediction with Conditional Diffusion

Accurate mobile traffic forecasting is crucial for network service management, supporting proactive capacity provisioning, congestion mitigation, and energy-efficient operation. However, many cities and regions are data-scarce (e.g., newly deployed or poorly instrumented areas), thus making traffic prediction a few-shot learning problem and limiting the practicality of standard data-driven models. Existing cross-city solutions primarily rely on data-space alignment to match traffic distributions between data-rich and data-scarce cities, but such alignment is often brittle under real-world distribution shifts, measurement noise, and city-specific bias. To address these limitations, we propose a Conditional Diffusion-based Parameter Generation (CDPG) framework. Instead of aligning raw data, CDPG learns the conditional distribution of high-performing predictor parameters for source cities and directly generates node-specific model parameters for the target city. To support reliable adaptation for network traffic prediction, CDPG conditions parameter generation on multi-modal spatio-temporal context. Specifically, CDPG captures spatial environment cues by combining satellite imagery wi…

item.title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening

Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, …

研究问题：RTL 仿真时间随设计规模快速增长；CPU/GPU 仿真吞吐受限，FPGA 仿真吞吐高但可扩展性受资源容量约束。

方法：FoldSim 自动框架在单块 FPGA 上做 cycle-exact 仿真：层级折叠把设计层次中的实例映射到共享逻辑、保持独立状态；编译器对可折叠模块类构造静态调度，降低动态同步开销、状态访问可预测；超容量状态放外部内存按需取回；可配置 DRAM 模型分离目标内存时序与 host 延迟。

关键数字：单块 AMD Alveo V80 跑 8-SM GPU 与 1024 节点 Rocket 数据中心（4096 核）；非折叠实现分别需约 16×/200× LUT；数据中心约 1.9GB 状态驻留 HBM；4-SM GPU 完成 1024×1024 GEMM 仅 4.24 秒（软件 RTL 仿真 26 小时）。

为什么值得看：把超大设计的 cycle-exact 仿真压进单块 FPGA，吞吐跨数量级提升。

item.title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：具身 agent 的 VLA/WAM 模型难泛化到 OOD 环境；检索成功经验做 warm-start 降噪可同时提升准确率与推理效率，但经验库扩展带来边缘系统难承受的存储与搜索开销。

方法：FlashX 是 CBA（CMOS Directly Bonded to Array）NAND flash 架构：借 CBA 高内部带宽做并行 pSLC key 搜索，交错 Compute-in-Flash（CIF）引擎维持感知吞吐、保留密集 TLC latent 存储；本体感知聚类降搜索开销并支持增量经验获取、免全局重聚类。

关键数字：VLA/WAM 任务成功率在密集/计算高效配置下分别最高提升 12.24%p/7.43%p；搜索吞吐为最强 prior NAND 搜索架构的 2.57×，聚类再降 9.7× 搜索；相对 SSD 检索端到端加速 1.29–3.95×、能效提升 1.12–2.34×。

为什么值得看：存储级方案化解具身 agent 经验复用的扩展瓶颈，精度与效率双赢。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：C/C++ 编译成功不代表 HLS 后 FPGA 硬件正确或高效。

方法：FPGA-GEN 是 agentic HLS-C 生成工作流，把规范、就绪、选择、修复、准入规则编码进显式任务契约与有界工具反馈循环，逐候选做决策。

关键数字：HLS-Eval 上每任务 5 个共享上下文输出，407/425（95.8%）公开 testbench 通过；累计转换中 104/107（97.2%）HLS-LeVeri 设计通过 held-out 协同仿真、Vivado 综合/适配与 same-RTL 证据；聚焦 TensorCore 筛选中候选 3 比生成/组合的 C0 少 73.7% CSynth cycles、14.6% LUT，多 26.7% DSP。

为什么值得看：把 HLS 代码生成做成受控 agentic 流程，正确率与硬件效率双高。

item.title: FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs

Fine-grained visual understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize small visual entities and understand their relationships. Scene graphs offer a natural way to represent this information, organizing visual entities as nodes and their relationships as edges. However, we identify two challenges: existing scene graph benchmarks provide insufficient coverage of fine-grained entities and the relationships among them, and existing methods for fine-grained visual understanding have yet to effectively leverage such graph-structured information in MLLMs. To address these challenges, we introduce Fine-Grained Multimodal Scene Graph Benchmark (FG-GraphBench) and FiGRA. FG-GraphBench is a benchmark comprising three complementary tasks: fine-grained visual question answering (FG-QA), image captioning (FG-Caption), and image description generation (FG-Description). We develop a two-stage construction pipeline that discovers and grounds fine-grained entities and establishes their relations to construct the fine-grained multimodal scene graphs (MSGs) in FG-GraphBench. Building on these MSGs, we propose FiGRA, a Fine-grained Graph Representation Augmentation method fo…

item.title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities

Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. item.title: Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies

We present an internal, pre-registered evaluation of the UCMT causal discovery algorithm family alongside established alternatives across heterogeneous benchmark regimes, complemented by a separately pre-registered, controlled study of UCMT v2 Global components. The contribution is both empirical and methodological: a family-stratified comparison of three actively developed algorithm configurations and targeted evidence about which internal stages affect their outcomes. In the main benchmark, UCMT v2 Global has higher directed F1 than NOTEARS and DAGMA in selected real, semi-synthetic and Gaussian-network comparisons at the paired-run level, while trailing leading permutation-search methods in other settings. The BOSS-based UCMT v4 produces a CSuite-specific directed-F1 improvement over BOSS (mean paired difference +0.279; pair-level Holm p < 0.001), but the dataset-level adjusted result is not significant (p = 0.188). In a separate fixed-skeleton ablation, UCMT v2 Global exceeds an adapted R^2-SortnRegress orientation baseline on standardized iSCM data (directed F1 0.537 vs 0.468, dataset-level Holm p = 0.031); absolute orientation accuracy is 0.563 and there is no established bro…

item.title: Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model

Global Workspace Theory (GWT), a leading theory of consciousness, holds that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast to specialized processes that use it. Building a workspace into a network does not reveal what the trained network computes with it: a module that reports an answer may have combined a broadcast message with its own knowledge, or merely forwarded an answer computed elsewhere, and task accuracy and ablation cannot tell these apart. We introduce a causal protocol that identifies who computes when modules communicate. Its central test transplants a message from another input, chosen so that ignoring, relaying and recombining it predict three different answers. On networks built to relay or to recombine, the test assigns the right computation in every case. Among trained workspace models it finds all three outcomes: one leaves its broadcast nearly unused, and of two models that differ only in their training data, one relays and the other recombines. In AFGW, a language model whose modules communicate only through a learned workspace, a transplanted message yields the answer that recombination predicts in 97% of cases, and its content acts by redirecting what t…

item.title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration

Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. item.title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback

Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $β_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-β_1)\|G_t\|_F + γ\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order $p^2/r^2$ by one of order $1$, against $Θ(p/r)$ for the sharpest contraction-based bounds. Transferring the full rate costs a leakage term, which we bound by the step-weighted gradient mass $\sum_{u\le t}η_u\|G_u\|_F$ and show tight up to a factor $\sqrt{2}$; th…

item.title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. Heuristic warm-starting uses inexpensive approximate rewards during an initial phase before switching to refinement with exact rewards. Reward correction combines inexpensive estimates with randomized exact evaluations, preserving the expected policy gradient while reducing the expected number of exact solves per update. item.description:

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Coordinate Basis Linear Bandits with Sublinear Regret over Low-Rank Clusters

We study the problem of computational efficiency for linear bandits in high-dimensional settings with a finite arm set. In linear bandits, the increase in the dimension $d$ of the feature vectors leads to growing computational costs of $O(d^2)$ at each round of update. Traditional low-rank approximation methods such as SOFUL reduce computation via fixed-size matrix sketching, yet run the risk of incurring vacuous linear regret when the spectral tail of the data is heavy and the approximation rank is inadequately selected. To guarantee regret convergence and effectively reduce computational costs, we introduce a clustering mechanism and propose the Coordinate Basis Linear Bandit (CBL) algorithm. Our method preserves the full covariance information in each cluster by maintaining an exact orthonormal basis of the cluster's column space together with a low-dimensional coordinate representation, which guarantees robust sublinear regret without spectral-tail vulnerabilities. item.title: Cooling Noisy Population Protocols -- Vanishing-Gain Averaging and Localisation under Persistent Errors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Cooling Noisy Population Protocols -- Vanishing-Gain Averaging and Localisation under Persistent Errors

We study noise-tolerant coordination in anonymous population protocols whose agents interact in uniformly random pairs, maintain real-valued labels, and have no global clock. Each agent cools its updates using a gain $γ_k=(k+1)^{-p}$ computed from its own local interaction counter. First, for pairwise averaging with independent communication errors drawn from a fixed centred finite-variance distribution, we prove convergence with probability 1 to a common finite random value for every $1/2<p\le1$, and derive convergence-rate exponents under the same assumptions. Second, for one-dimensional localisation with fixed non-degenerate Gaussian displacement errors, we show that the one-sided RightAlign rule rectifies centred noise and cannot stabilise; a signed update based on the relative-position discrepancy restores convergence to the true agents locations up to one finite random translation. Third, we analyse the setting in which both communication errors and displacement-measurement errors depend on the physical distance between the interacting devices. item.title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：训练后低秩压缩既要近似权重、更要保持模型输入-输出行为；现有 output-aware 方法按观测 next token 或模型预测概率加权 logit 变化，权重有偏。

方法：Complete-SVD 最小化原始与压缩模型 logits 的 L2 距离、所有 logit 变化等权；线性化 + Kronecker 近似把目标化为带闭式解的加权 SVD；输出侧因子不可解，用随机探针无偏估计（每条序列 K 次反向传播，与词表大小和序列长度无关）；另评估 KL 变体（KL-SVD）。

关键数字：均匀秩 + WikiText-2 校准下 C4/PTB 困惑度全部设置最低，ratio 0.7 LEMS 分配下同样最低；KL-SVD 多数设置校准困惑度更低、下游准确率更高但跨语料困惑度升高；IFEval 指令跟随准确率全程优于最强 prior output-aware 方法。

为什么值得看：对压缩误差度量的重新思考，闭式解 + 无偏估计兼顾理论与实用。

item.title: CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables

Automated analog circuit sizing methods, from black-box optimizers to recent large language model (LLM) agents, typically search the design space with a SPICE simulator in the loop, whereas an experienced designer works out a design by hand analysis. This paper presents CRAFT, a flow in which an LLM agent designs a given topology by calculation, as a designer does, and without an initial sizing. The agent works only through DeX, a service that uses pre-computed lookup tables to provide device characteristics and to solve the whole netlist for its operating point and small-signal response. It thus designs without SPICE, and every final design is verified independently in HSPICE. We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints. With Claude Opus 5.5, CRAFT meets every specification and constraint in all 20 runs, five per circuit. On that amplifier, with DeX in place of HSPICE and an identical request for both, the same agent passes in 10 of 10 runs instead of 6 of 10 within an hour and is 2.0x faster at the median.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

研究问题：gem5 等高级模拟器缺乏对硬件可实现性的反馈、常与真实设计性能脱节；手工把模拟器代码转高质量 RTL 又需要大团队。

方法：BOOMerang 构建 agentic loops 自动化双向转换：(1) 自动为 BOOM 核在 gem5 生成对齐的高层模型；(2) 把模拟器中的新微架构特性忠实转回 RTL。

关键数字：生成的 gem5 模型 IPC 与 RTL 相差 3% 以内（仅 2 天）；自动把 72 个特性转回 BOOM RTL 且保持低 IPC 误差；组合优化使 BOOM RTL 在 SPECint 2017 性能提升 25%；产物开源。

为什么值得看：模拟器与 RTL 双向自动对齐，让小型团队也能做实现级微架构研究。

item.title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity

Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models

Differentiable programming enables online calibration of numerical models by minimizing errors accumulated along simulated trajectories. This includes estimating physical parameters and training neural sub-models in hybrid configurations. Gradients are typically computed using adjoint methods, or backpropagation through time (BPTT), whose computational and memory costs grow with the length of the training window. This limits the duration and resolution of hybrid-model training, a major bottleneck for realistic geophysical applications. Approaches like truncated BPTT reduces memory use by discarding sensitivities across truncation boundaries, introducing gradient bias and neglecting long-range dependencies. We propose a class of gradient approximation methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators within it. Exact pullbacks are computed by automatic differentiation at sparse anchor states only. Between anchors, sensitivities propagate either through the identity (Zero-order) or through a reused, frozen pullback (Pullback Reuse). item.title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model

We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. In a cross-business transfer experiment, pretraining improves the target business metric by 34.5% over the same architecture trained from scratch. With only 25% of the training labels, the pretrained model outperforms the full-label scratch baseline in Average Precision (AP) and Recall@0.5% on different merchant domains. In a four-month online experiment on Ant International's billion-scale payment platform, the model reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% relative to XGB-Online.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM agent 多轮程序上下文逐轮增长，服务受 KV cache 容量限制；现有压缩等缓存超阈值后一次性总结大段历史，且与在服务请求竞争算力与内存。

方法：Aggron 每轮总结 agentic 请求、只选择性压缩部分 KV cache，保持精度并让总结轻量；从独立 Summarization Queue 发起总结，利用主队列 head-of-line 停滞留下的算力/内存余量；仅当预测总结能在对应请求最终执行前完成时才发出。

关键数字：高负载下相对 SOTA 异步总结，P99 程序延迟降低 27–31%，吞吐提升 1.34–1.40×。

为什么值得看：把 KV 压缩塞进 HOL 停滞的空闲窗口，近乎零额外竞争。

为什么值得看：把 KV 压缩塞进 HOL 停滞的空闲窗口，近乎零额外竞争。

item.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher

Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at de…

item.title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoBA（Mixture of Block Attention）按查询选 KV 块降长上下文算量，但 FlashMoBA 固定 Top-k 预算与 query-centric 调度：一个预算套不同分数分布、query-range 所有权碎片化 K/V 复用。

方法：LightningMoBA 协同设计选择与执行：动态路由阈值化每查询块分数、直接产出可变基数稀疏元数据；KV-centric ownership 按 (query head, KV block) 列分组、拆分高扇出列为有界任务并复用已加载 KV tile；Hopper 上运行时流水线重叠 K/V 传输与 Tensor Core 计算。

关键数字：匹配 Top-16 保留下五个 checkpoint 端到端生成加速 1.20–1.60×，平均 RULER 分数从 74.42 升至 75.28。

为什么值得看：MoBA 从路由到执行的系统级协同优化，保留率不降反升。

item.title: A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs

Low-rank plus sparse decompositions, such as robust PCA, typically model the low-rank component as dense and the sparse component as corruption. This viewpoint is poorly suited to graph adjacency matrices, where sparsity is structural and dense low-rank factors destroy the combinatorial and computational properties of the graph. We propose signed biclique decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that represents the structured component as a sum of sparse signed binary rank-one factors, together with a sparse signed residual. The resulting representation remains discrete, interpretable, sparse, and compatible with standard linear algebra. We formulate fixed-rank and greedy SBD objectives and derive a gain-based greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, SBD recovers block structure in noisy graphs, while its factorized representation enables efficient sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM). On real graphs with strong shared-neighborhood structure, SBD achieves compression factors above $10$ and SpMM speedups up to $6\times$ over cuSPARSE, suggesting a practical alternative to dense low-rank decompositions for graphs. item.title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals

Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. This low-frequency estimation parameterizes a static milling force model that reconstructs the force behavior over one spindle revolution. Although the static model does not reproduce all dynamic effects, it captures the force distribution, load levels, and angular regions of highest tool engagemen…

item.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

eFAIR：小时级电力承诺预算下的公平 LLM serving 调度

Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget allocation, and GPU frequency selection through a common normalized-throughput target. Specifically, request dispatching prioritizes requests by desired service level and progress; electricity budget alloca…

item.title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经网络量化误差的 zonotope 抽象解释

Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

生存基准未告诉你的事：模型选择与数据集 regime 的影响

Despite the proliferation of survival analysis methods, current benchmarks often operate under narrow conditions: they heavily rely on the concordance index (C-index) for evaluation and model selection, and frequently either exclude deep learning (DL) methods or underrepresent challenging dataset regimes. To address these limitations, we conduct a large-scale, neutral benchmark comparing 10 classical, tree-based, and DL methods across 49 diverse datasets. Crucially, we treat the model selection criterion (optimizing for C-index, Integrated Brier Score (IBS), or Mean Absolute Error (MAE-PO)) as an independent experimental variable. Using Bayesian mixed-effects modeling, we demonstrate that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions. For complex DL and tree-based architectures, selecting hyperparameters to optimize for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration at a negligible cost to discriminative ranking. Furthermore, method performance (C-index, IBS, MAE-PO, and X-CAL) is fundamentally governed by dataset characteristics. While DL models scale exceptionally well with larger sample sizes, they suffer notable performance dro…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

方差最优反事实策略设计：样本高效的在线 A/B 测试

Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average t…

item.title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

VAFL：垂直解析联邦学习，闭式解的高效众包服务

Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. item.title: Twindex: Index Cache Offloading with Coarse-to-Fine Selection for Long-Context Sparse-Attention Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文解码中主 KV 移到 host 内存后，indexer cache 成为 HBM 瓶颈——在 Qwen 上占单请求 HBM 的 63%、DeepSeek V4.1 上 75%（1M tokens）。

方法：Twindex 在 HBM 只保留紧凑的 indexer cache 副本、完整 cache 放 host；每步副本先选更大候选集，模型自己的 indexer 再从 host 原始行中取 top-k；副本=共享成分+压缩残差（离线学一次），不改模型权重、运行在 CUDA graphs 内。

关键数字：1M tokens 现代 GPU 上比仅 KV offloading 多容纳 1.78×/1.62×/3.03× 请求（Qwen/V4.1/GLM-5.2）；host 不限制批大小时 decode 吞吐达 1.44×/1.25×/2.54×；平均基准分数最多低 3.1%。

为什么值得看：把长上下文稀疏注意力服务的 indexer 瓶颈用粗到细两级选择解开。

item.title: TripleKV: Predict, Prefetch, Protect -- KV Cache Management for AI Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM agent 在推理与工具执行间切换、反复复用增长中的上下文，高并发下 KV cache 工作集可达数百 GiB，被逐出的块在 agent 返回时触发昂贵的重取、阻塞推理。

方法：TripleKV 三层 KV 缓存管理：工具感知延迟预测器预估工具调用完成时间、提前把所需 KV 块从 SSD 预取到 host DRAM（避开稀缺 GPU 内存）；消除 DRAM 中 GPU 驻留块的重复；victim-cache 在块被逐出 GPU 时从 SSD 回填。

关键数字：数据/web/编码 agent 上关键路径 SSD 读取占比从 45–76% 降至 10% 以下；P95 TTFT 相对带 DRAM/SSD 分层的 vLLM 最高降 49%，比近期 agent-aware 系统低 1.5–7×。

为什么值得看：利用 agent 工具执行间隙做预取，把重取延迟藏进空闲窗口。

为什么值得看：利用 agent 工具执行间隙做预取，把重取延迟藏进空闲窗口。
