item.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

将人脑组织分析迁移到语言模型

During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.

item.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经交流潮流模型的分布外泛化

Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TechReport: Implementing CHERI in gem5
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TechReport：在 gem5 中实现 CHERI 能力安全模型

Despite countless mitigation efforts, memory safety issues still prevail. The recently discovered security issues in PHP underline this fact. One of the most promising approaches to solving this problem is the concept of Capability Hardware Enhanced RISC Instructions (CHERI). There is a well-developed ecosystem of ISA simulators, compilers, operating systems, and hardware designs that support CHERI. However, the lack of a simulator modeling microarchitectural detail hinders efficient and fast design space exploration for CHERI-enhanced designs means the performance impact of CHERI remains understudied. Therefore, we present gem5-CHERI: a CHERI-enhanced adaptation of the gem5 simulator that can boot the CheriBSD operating system and run custom workloads. The simulator is available open-source on GitHub.

item.title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TangentPDE：稀疏有限差分监督学习局部算子响应

Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jacobians, and remains applicable to nonlinear solvers without derivative interfaces. Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TabBioMed：大规模生物医学表格学习基准

Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. item.title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

凸/半凸/拟凸函数的结构保持神经逼近

Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. item.title: Stephen: Verifying Sequencer-Aided Coordination Systems with Cross-View Prophecy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

验证 sequencer 辅助协调系统：跨视图 prophecy 方法验证 SMR/分布式事务

Many distributed systems achieve high performance by relying on dedicated sequencers to order requests, leaving replicas to commit them in that order. Despite more than a decade of such sequencer-aided coordination (SAC) systems, from Corfu and NOPaxos to LazyLog and SwitchBFT, their correctness has been argued only with pen-and-paper proofs or bounded model checking at the protocol level. In this paper, we formally verify implementations of SAC protocols. The sequencer seems to make this easy: it decides the order of all requests, so the proof can place each request's linearization point at the sequencer using a well-known technique, prophecy variables. Yet a linearization point placed at the sequencer is not durable, because the sequencer orders a request before any replica commits it. Crashes and other rare events may trigger a view change that discards the request, nullifying the earlier decision and the proof that rests on it. Our framework, Stephen, extends prophecy variables to handle view changes, and we make three contributions. item.title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中从其他客户端窃取精确训练数据（梯度反演）

Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning

Split federated learning (SFL) distributes neural networks across clients and a server, coupling class-specific knowledge across their representations. This coupling complicates split federated unlearning (SFU), where class-wise forgetting must remove target knowledge while preserving retained utility under heterogeneous representation spaces and asymmetric update constraints. We propose SplitReAlign, a partition-aware representation realignment framework for class-wise SFU. It constructs endpoint-specific discriminative subspaces coordinated through a shared semantic anchor, selectively realigning forgotten representations while penalizing changes outside the active subspaces. To accommodate asymmetric update constraints, SplitReAlign leverages gradients through frozen servers for Client-only updates and fixed client-feature statistics for Server-only guidance, while Joint updates optimize both partitions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under heterogeneous client distributions demonstrate that SplitReAlign achieves the lowest average gap to retraining among all compared methods across six settings. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SoU-RHS：贝叶斯结构化稀疏恢复 CNN 紧凑架构

Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. Across standard image-classification benchmarks, SoU-RHS recovers substantially smaller architectures than deterministic structured-sparsity baselines, while maintaining competitive accuracy, achieving lower negative log-…

item.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

更简单的微型递归模型（TRM 变体）

Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. item.title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders

Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across diverse encoder-SAE configurations on two vision datasets and two language corpora, DualSAE achieves mean relative improvements of approximately 29% in reconstruction fidelity and 34% in interpretability (measured by monosemanticity score). Autoscaling enables cloud-native applications to meet their SLOs by dynamically adjusting computational resources at runtime. Recent research has explored a broad range of advanced autoscaling approaches, including rule-based, optimisation-based, and machine learning-based techniques, to address the limitations of traditional resource management strategies in cloud-native environments. Despite significant advances, a considerable gap remains between academic innovations and their practical adoption in real-world environments. For instance, Kubernetes deployments commonly rely on the reactive, CPU-based Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, limiting the adoption of more advanced autoscaling approaches. item.title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中 LoRA 重分配的 rank 预算再思考

Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. item.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

长程 RL 专家的 off-policy 巩固：重放而非重采样（替代 MOPD）

Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. item.title: Reliable arithmetic circuits using less reliable (sub-digital) logic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

用更不可靠的亚数字逻辑构造可靠算术电路：推翻超低电压静态失效壁垒

The frequent static failure of CMOS logic gates at ultra-low voltages has historically been perceived as a strict barrier to extreme voltage scaling: this paper introduces a statistical circuit law proving this intuition wrong. We discovered a universal power law connecting gate and circuit static failure probabilities, revealing that circuit failure requires the simultaneous breakdown of an entire gate cluster rather than a single component. Because the required cluster size increases rapidly as voltage drops, low-voltage \textit{sub-digital} logic exhibits surprising inherent resilience to static failure. This insight stems from new theoretical tools we developed to quantify static failure, extending well beyond conventional voltage-margin analysis. Consequently, sub-digital processors could potentially offer a viable, near-term solution to drastically reduce the energy demands of AI.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧学习（ODL）加速器面临反向传播代价高、类超向量存储/推理能耗大、精度敏感子集易受模拟 CIM 误差影响等问题。

方法 ReCIM-HD 集成无梯度超维计算（HDC）+ ReRAM 模拟 CIM：ReRAM 非易失存储类超向量并做 CIM 相似度搜索，空闲可断电不丢数据；混合数字-模拟 CIM 推理流把精度关键小子集走数字保护；Kronecker HD 编码器降编码开销 + 定制 ISA。

关键数字 40nm 流片，44.17 TOPS/W（混合模式）、75.8 TOPS/W（ReRAM CIM 模式），能效最高比 SOTA 加速器高 20.1×。

为什么值得看 无反向传播的端侧学习 + ReRAM CIM，能效数据亮眼，类脑/HD 计算方向值得跟踪。

item.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 agent 驱动的优化基准多聚焦单软件层（如 kernel），不清楚 agent 能否在生产负载下带来端到端性能提升。

方法 RSIBench-Infra 基准：20 个训练/推理任务、覆盖多模型家族与模态，最多 32 加速器的 NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU 部署；agent 从官方配方的可运行基线出发，可改 engine/kernel/指令层软件栈，OCI 镜像层提交协议保证可复现部署，独立评测端到端性能。

关键数字 全部任务结果中 66.2% 超过 1.10× 已验证加速。

为什么值得看 首个评估 agent 优化生产级训练/推理基础设施的基准，结论务实——agent 能提升，但端到端转化仍难。

item.title: Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing

Printed porous layouts interleave functional material with open channels, and the layout that uses the material best depends on how the process settings shape the deposit. Generative models propose layouts quickly, but a generator that does not receive the process setting samples from the same distribution at every setting, even when the process-dependent score ranks candidate layouts differently. This paper examines whether process knowledge can steer a latent diffusion generator toward layouts suited to a given process setting in a prescribed design domain. We formulate a process-dependent utilization score in which a process model sets the length over which the utility of printed material decays with distance from a channel. The generator combines a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) latent representation, a topology U-Net, a ControlNet domain branch, and a separately trained regressor that predicts the score from noised latents; the domain branch conditions each denoising step and the regressor gradient steers it. The method is applied to aerosol jet printing, where the atomizer and sheath gas flows enter the score through the flow-focusing relation. Across seven…

item.description:

运动扩散模型对其自身估计的物理探测

Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. item.title: Predicting Process-Level Behavior: A Benchmarking Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

预测流程级行为：基准研究（预测式流程监控）

Predictive process monitoring (PPM) typically forecasts the future of individual process instances, hence operating on trace level. Process managers, however, typically operate on process level, e.g., when assigning staff or calculating KPIs. The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions. We answer this question through a comprehensive benchmarking study of two process-level prediction tasks: concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction. Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level. We assess which modeling paradigms are most suitable for predicting process-level behavior and whether existing trace-level PPM can be effectively repurposed for this task. Our results show substantial variation in performance across approaches. Notably, aggregated trace-level predictions cause errors to compound on process-level, reducing a…

item.title: Pack Light, Walk Fast: Compact Page-Table Residency in Shared Caches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：硬件页表 walker 经缓存层次取描述符，页表 walk 与应用数据争用共享缓存；保留叶子行避免 DRAM 读，但映射足迹增大时又挤占应用数据。

方法：LeafPack 在标准缓存路内原地压缩架构页表叶子行——利用相邻描述符物理帧号与属性的规律性，最多 16 条 64B 叶子行打包进含元数据的 80B 槽；增量打包、按需重建、不规则行不压缩；运行时 set-dueling 控制器在压缩/非压缩路上限间自适应。

关键数字：Arm gem5 全系统模拟（1–8 核），9 个翻译密集负载几何平均加速 28.7%/28.4%（小核/服务器核，相对基线共享缓存）、18.7%/17.7%（相对 SRRIP）；20 个冻结控制器后的未见混合负载全部提速，几何平均 21.4%/18.5%。

为什么值得看：页表缓存压缩兼顾翻译覆盖与应用数据容量，多核翻译密集负载一致受益。

item.title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

PGU-Decoder：先验引导的工业路网地图更新统一解码

Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all thr…

Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. item.title: Neural Memory Orchestration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 HPC 工作负载越来越卡在内存层次而非计算，mmap 文件/swap/分层内存的缺页占墙钟时间越来越大；内核启发式预取对不规则、数据相关的访问流退化严重。

方法 Overseer 端到端学习式页预取系统：eBPF 采集器观察缺页，transformer 预测器 OverNet 在网附推理硬件上发出未来页地址，内核驻留执行器提前物化页面；OverNet 用 per-instance 序数秩编码增量，单模型即可服务任意目标进程、无需重训。

关键数字 两个缺页重型负载上运行时间约降 35%（Hilbert 曲线遍历）与约一个数量级（稠密矩阵乘法），major-fault 计数相应减少。

为什么值得看 学习式预取首次走到真实硬件部署管线，eBPF+网附推理架构对 HPC 内存瓶颈有直接价值。

item.title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes

The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way. The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Native FPGA Hard-Block Implementation from High-Level Synthesis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：HLS 映射到 FPGA 硬块时常闲置其算术模式、内部寄存器与级联链路，又在 fabric 里重建，浪费面积与时序。

方法：C++ 模板库不改 HLS 编译器即达到原生硬块实现：模板固定源码模式，自动流程挑选调度设置与经验证的 RTL 补丁。

关键数字：AMD Versal 上矩阵乘法比 AutoSA 脉动阵列少用 2.4–4.5× LUT、吞吐相当或更高；INT8 矩阵-向量单元达到手写 FINN RTL 的每 DSP 3 MAC（HLS 库至多 1.29）；在 hls4ml、Allo、Stream-HLS 中 LUT 最多减 2.7×、DSP 最多减 2×。

为什么值得看：不侵入编译器即可吃满 FPGA 硬块，提升 HLS 生成质量的上限。

item.title: Multilevel Graph Partitioning on GPU Supercomputers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

GPU 超级计算机上的多级图划分算法与实现

Graph partitioning is a key enabler in computational science, with applications to sparse linear algebra, load-balanced parallel computation, and graph computations. In recent years, graphics processing units (GPUs) have become the preferred accelerator on the world's top supercomputers. Despite this, most existing distributed graph partitioners do not utilize GPUs. In this work, we develop a new multi-GPU distributed partitioner based on Jet, a prior single-GPU partitioner. We seek to optimize scalability without sacrificing quality. Our partitioner utilizes CUDA-aware MPI, one-sided communication routines, and an overall bulk-synchronous parallel structure. We demonstrate solution quality comparable to Jet. Our experiments show excellent weak scaling up to 256 GPUs, enabling partitioning of instances significantly larger than a single-GPU partitioner can handle.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark

Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. item.title: Mode Inference for Substructural Adjoint Types
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Mode Inference for Substructural Adjoint Types

Adjoint types [Jang et al. 2024] provide a method of mixing substructural modes (for example, linear, affine, strict, or unrestricted) in a type system while preserving the proof-theoretic and computational properties of each mode. Uses of such a system include performing compiler optimizations or providing safety guarantees on parts of a program whose modes support them, while not restricting the programmer's ability to write other code as they usually do. However, Jang et al.'s algorithmic type system is monomorphic in the modes, requiring the programmer to anticipate a potentially large number of combinations of modes, and possibly copy code to conform to each of them. In this paper we define a mode inference algorithm for programs with adjoint types that produces principal modes, summarizing all possible substructural modes of a function in a simple constraint language. This removes the burden from the programmer to a priori analyze the substructural properties of their code, and, furthermore, allows a single function definition to subsume all its instances at different modes. We show that our system is sound and complete with respect to a mild restriction of Jang et al.'s mono…

item.title: Mine Locally, Verify Globally: Exact Recovery, Compilation, and Distortion of Mined Temporal Rules
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

分布式监控中的时序规则挖掘：本地挖掘+全局验证的精确恢复与编译

Specification mining extracts temporal rules that describe relationships between events in recorded system traces. Applying these rules in distributed monitoring systems is more difficult because observations come from different nodes, whose clocks may not be synchronized, and events may be lost or reordered during transmission. In this paper, we study how to aggregate the coverage of mined rules across observers, determine whether their temporal windows are needed during monitoring, and characterize their detection under event loss. Our evaluation uses IPv6 packet traces collected from 21 receivers across four continents. We show that local mining followed by global confirmation recovers centralized rule coverage under suitable conditions while substantially reducing communication overhead. In contrast, merging traces with unaligned clocks can distort coverage by introducing incorrect temporal matches. A window-gain criterion identifies rules that require temporal state, while our loss analysis and broker experiments demonstrate why contiguous losses can be more damaging than independent losses. The results identify separate requirements for aggregating observations, selecting mon…

item.title: MicroAssert: Microarchitecture-Aware Structured Assertion Generation for CPU Verification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

MicroAssert：微架构感知的 CPU 验证断言自动生成

Automatic assertion generation reduces manual verification effort, yet existing approaches struggle to capture microarchitectural behaviors and cross-region interactions in CPUs. We present MicroAssert, a microarchitecture-aware framework that identifies functional regions directly from RTL and generates local and composite assertions through structured contracts and deterministic verification primitives. Coverage-guided feedback further improves verification completeness by progressively expanding proof-relevant RTL coverage. Evaluated on five open-source RISC-V CPUs against three existing assertion generation approaches, MicroAssert achieves 100% syntax correctness and complete branch, statement, and toggle coverage, with an average proven rate of 74.82% and Proof Core coverage of 90.96%. Mutation testing further demonstrates its advantage, achieving an average error detection rate of 28.73%, 1.99 to 3.51 times higher than existing methods. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of microarchitecture-aware assertion generation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

关键数字 6 个 LLM 负载×16 部署配置下，74% prefill、87.5% decode 设置达 best-or-tied-best 延迟，模拟调用量约为对比 DSE 基线的一半。

关键数字 6 个 LLM 负载×16 部署配置下，74% prefill、87.5% decode 设置达 best-or-tied-best 延迟，模拟调用量约为对比 DSE 基线的一半。

为什么值得看 把"模拟器为什么慢"变成可解释的机理模型，显著省模拟预算，NPU DSE 效率提升直观。

item.title: Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

长上下文 LLM 服务的保留上下文计量与计费框架（三层分离）

Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. The framework provides a bounded per-token accounting rule and measured deployment constraints, rather than a validated utility estimator.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types

Face presentation attack detection (PAD) systems deployed in border control and airport surveillance are constrained by a critical assumption: subjects are captured at close range, typically under one meter. No existing benchmark systematically addresses multi-distance capture, diverse environmental conditions, and concurrent spoofing and occlusion-based attacks, leaving deployed models underprepared for real-world scenarios. We introduce a video-based PAD dataset of 374,000+ frames from 261 unique identities collected across five standoff distances (1 m-100 m) under indoor and outdoor conditions using a DSLR camera (C) and a mobile sensor (M), with three-class labels: live, spoof, and props (occlusions); models are trained and evaluated on video clips rather than single frames. We fine-tune and benchmark four CNN architectures: MobileNetV3, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and ResNet-50. The higher-resolution DSLR maintains near-perfect spoof classification rate across all distances, while the lower-resolution mobile sensor degrades sharply beyond 50 m, with props classification rate dropping to 55% at 75 m for MobileNetV3. EfficientNet achieves the best overall performance (98.48% accura…

item.title: Lodestone: Automated Semantic Discovery of Datacenter Hardware Specialization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 识别数据中心值得专用硬件的计算很难：热点函数/指令模式分析会漏掉分散在应用与库中、被不同代码掩盖的同一底层计算。

方法 Lodestone agentic 框架：从执行迹提取热点控制流区打包成可分析单元；agent 描述每个区计算什么、把相同计算合并为家族并循环校验语义；用参考输入输出验证家族；为选定家族提议 ISA 扩展/近核单元/分离加速器，由人类专家决定推进。

关键数字 20 个负载（6 类数据中心工作负载）发现 30 个家族，周期精确模拟+RTL 实现后平均提速 12.6%、最高 80.2%。

为什么值得看 用 agent 语义推理做硬件特化机会发现，比热函数分析覆盖面广，自动化程度高。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Serverless 流处理的局部性感知调度，面向有状态 FaaS 流水线

Stateful Serverless (Function-as-a-Service) environment are increasingly used for stream processing applications. These applications are often structured as pipelines where data flows through a sequence of distinct processing operators. Many operators are stateful and require access to the processing state during execution. To address this, stateful serverless platforms introduce state servers on worker nodes, co-locating state with computation to dramatically reduce access latency. In serverless, these data pipelines are realized by chaining function invocations, passing the processed data from one function to the next. To reduce network overhead, state-of-the-art scheduling approaches employ a distributed worker-level scheduling model, routing locally generated chained requests directly to destination workers, bypassing centralized schedulers. However, these approaches always co-locate state and execution for the same operator in the same worker, which forces most invocations to the next operator to be transferred across workers, thereby increasing both latency and I/O overhead. item.title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models

Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separate follow-up sized to allow one failure yielded 472 of 473. On 1,000-event room-swap documents, three of ten models solved all five documents by reasoning alone. All seven models tested both ways at this length solved all five with extraction and the …

item.title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧小模型想靠"每晚从白天工作中学"持续改进，但缺乏真实结果时，谁来决定哪些尝试值得学——模型自判和用户反应都可能错。

方法 Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B + LoRA，每晚用 judge 接受的尝试微调，在 WebShop 与 τ²-bench 上跑 127 条"生命"（最长一年）；对比真实结果、用户口头判定、模型自判与一个冻结的"反馈感知"（读用户反应，三个版本）。

关键数字 自判模型先提升后衰减；把礼貌放弃当成功的感知崩了 3/5 条生命；会分辨的感知两周内 4/5 接近 oracle，第 60 天回落到自判水平；97 条生命中失败尝试占比预测学习效果（Spearman ρ=-0.81）。

为什么值得看 对"设备端从反馈自学"做系统长程实验，结论反直觉——反馈质量与结果可见性是生死线。

item.title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

LLM 辅助多保真贝叶斯优化：融合专家知识与数值数据

Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventio…

item.title: LEDGE: An Efficient Simulator for Distributed LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 评估异构边缘设备上分布式 LLM serving 需探索模型切分、设备放置与网络条件，反复做物理实验代价高昂。

方法 LEDGE 轻量模拟器，不执行张量操作：事件图支持非均匀张量/流水线并行，用端到端标定的可复用性能模型估执行成本，并模拟共享链路争用。

关键数字 10 台 Jetson/Raspberry Pi 异构测试床、4 个 LLM 家族 17 种模型-精度组合上，Qwen 部署请求级 MAPE <3.6%，较物理推理聚合加速 135.3×；跨家族零样本延迟 MAPE 7.44%；26,773 次模拟在 83.8 分钟内完成。

为什么值得看 异构边缘 LLM serving 的可复用仿真器，开销低、泛化尚可，做部署策略探索很省事。

item.title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Kernel Ridge Attention：带选择性遗忘的非线性记忆循环序列混合器

Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：推荐系统的稀疏 embedding 层内存压力大，训练中剪枝（ITEP）按大小启发式设每表剪枝率，可能损害精度。

方法：用特征重要性（FI）指导剪枝率（FI-ITEP），对低重要特征关联的表分配更高剪枝比例；FI 信号计算成本极低。

关键数字：三个大规模推荐模型总内存减少 20–40%，精度不降或提升；同样的模型 GPU trainer 从 112 台减至 80 台、单卡吞吐更高，每次模型启动省 1,000+ GPU 小时；开源 DLRM（Criteo 1TB）上复现趋势。

为什么值得看：低成本特征重要性把 embedding 剪枝的内存收益转化为真实训练成本节省。

item.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Agentic Hardware Verification Workflows: A Multi-Strategy Characterization Across Protocol Complexity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Agentic 硬件验证工作流中的推理时扩展：多策略刻画

Inference-time scaling, allocating more compute during generation rather than pre-training, has demonstrated dramatic quality improvements for LLM reasoning tasks. Its behaviour in structured hardware verification code generation, where outputs must satisfy compiler correctness, protocol semantics, and functional coverage constraints simultaneously, is less understood. We present a systematic, simulator-grounded study of inference-time compute scaling for agentic UVM testbench synthesis targeting AMBA protocol bridges. Four inference strategies---zero-shot (\$0.04), raw-feedback iterative (\$0.81), structured inner-loop (\$0.95), and full dual-loop agentic synthesis (\$1.06)---are evaluated across four AMBA targets (Protocol Complexity Index 11.8--22.6) using the Protocol Verification Completeness (PVC) metric, functional coverage, and a six-class UVM error taxonomy (E1--E6). item.title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

ICICLE：上下文内推理的曲线学习外推（freeze-thaw BO）

Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. item.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 持续学习（CL）移植到真实边缘设备面临两大难题：在线单样本流需实时适应，低 footprint 使传统反向传播训练不可行。

方法 借鉴大脑清醒/睡眠周期，Hypnos 双阶段平台：清醒阶段用低 footprint RISC-V MCU SoC 做高效推理+无梯度原型更新（快速低耗适应）；睡眠阶段由智能充电器执行基于 rehearsal 的梯度更新（长期巩固）。

关键数字 CORe50 NICv2-391 上创边缘 CL 新 SOTA 准确率 78.6%–81.6%，每样本端侧延迟 7.79–10.54 s；比量化 latent replay 少 3.8× 学习步数、22× 学习算力。

为什么值得看 睡眠/清醒双相训练把"白天快速适应、夜间巩固"落成开源平台，能耗/算力瓶颈处理巧妙。

item.title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

把注意力网络变成可解释硬逻辑谓词电路：真值表谓词

We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same twe…

item.title: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLA 模型动作头推理受内存带宽限制——每步从 DRAM 重读全部权重，却只应用于约五十个 token，延迟与能耗由传输的权重比特数决定。

方法 观察到后续 flow step 会衰减前面步骤的量化误差，提出动作头权重精度随步数递增（2→4 bit）；并设计可编程加速器：DRAM 速率解码熵编码权重的 bit-serial 子阵列，运行时分配器在 linear 层与 attention 间分配，bank 端 requantizer+熵编码器让一份 8-bit 副本替代所有宽度副本。

关键数字 递增宽度比每步 4-bit 少传 25% 比特且保持闭环成功率；RTL 实现跑 GR00T N1.6 动作头单次推理 8.02 ms，比 Thor NVFP4 快 1.7×、能耗低 9.1×。

为什么值得看 把"精度随流步递增"的洞察落到硬件，无校准无训练保成功率，对端侧 VLA 加速很实用。

item.title: HapBO: Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization via Expert Natural Language Priors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

HapBO: Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization via Expert Natural Language Priors

Bayesian Optimization (BO) can be substantially more sample-efficient when informed by prior knowledge about the problem. In practice, however, such knowledge is often available only in natural language, e.g., expert intuitions or documentation, rather than as the explicit probability distribution landscape that prior-guided BO methods may require. Leveraging it effectively demands both an expressive mapping from language to priors and robustness to information that may be misleading. We propose HapBO (Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization), which elicits beliefs once from a human expert, a large language model (LLM), or both, and deterministically compiles a structured specification into a reusable belief function ($π: \mathcal{X} \to[0,1]$), with a rich representation not restricted to a Gaussian family. Building on $α$-$π$BO, HapBO applies this belief function through a bounded positive multiplier on any nonnegative acquisition, preserving positive acquisition support and requiring no LLM calls during optimization. We prove that, for the Expected Improvement acquisition function (EI), HapBO preserves the standard simple-regret rate up to a bounded factor, even under adversaria…

item.title: HETEROVLM: Edge Multi-Request Vision-Language Model Serving on a Heterogeneous Versal SoC with AI Engines and Programmable Logic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘自动驾驶/机器人需并发服务 deadline 各异的 VLM 请求，GPU 数据中心式 host 调度会让紧急请求久等、小 batch decode 单位 token 能耗高；Versal AIE SoC 既有加速器只映射单模型单输入流、无 decode/请求调度。

方法 HETEROVLM 在异构 Versal SoC 上做多请求 VLM serving：AIE 数组跑 encoder/prefill/attention，可编程逻辑（PL）实现 GEMV 引擎与小 decode 步调度器（按类别和 deadline 排序）；并发请求共享一次读权重的 decode 步，紧急请求在工作单元边界抢占。

关键数字 VC1902 上文本/相机问题首 token 140/303 ms；单请求 decode 比 Tesla T4、Jetson Orin Nano Super 快 1.3×/4.0×，每 token 能耗为其 61%/73%（RTX 3090 Ti 的 51%）。

为什么值得看 边缘多请求 VLM serving 的完整系统方案，AIE+PL 异构分工与抢占调度思路清晰。

item.title: Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing

Can the allocation used to train experts also predict which expert will perform best on a prompt? Such a connection would make the intended division of labor inspectable before training and allow the allocation itself to guide inference. We introduce InflEns, a mixture of LoRA experts whose training weights and inference routes come from the same location game in a fixed prompt-trait space. Players choose positions to maximize their expected shares of the prompt distribution, without using expert losses. We utilize the game's kernel-general theoretical criterion for when co-located positions become locally unstable to separation. We evaluate InflEns on a corpus assembled from seven safety-related benchmarks, which demonstrates that the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out response negative log-likelihood (NLL) on approximately 90% of prompts across four kernels under a sharpened simplex representation, compared with approximately 15% after permuting allocations across prompts. We demonstrate that the method performs comparably to published learned gates without having to train an explicit gate on the experts. Because the router is fixed, we can trace harmful behavior to a s…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

自学习生产级边缘栈：可持续 HVAC 控制（数据到阀门）

Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions alone, with a behaviour anchor and critic calibration terms, is scored by four model-free metrics and promoted by atomic hot-swap. item.title: Federated Learning of Car Aerodynamics Surrogates with Spectral Optimizers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Federated Learning of Car Aerodynamics Surrogates with Spectral Optimizers

Neural surrogates predict the aerodynamic forces on a car in seconds, compared with hours for a CFD simulation, but training them requires thousands of CFD simulations of different car designs, which car manufacturers keep proprietary. Federated learning allows several manufacturers to train a shared surrogate without exchanging data. We study which federated optimizer brings such a surrogate closest to one trained on pooled data. On DrivAerNet++, we train a Transolver surrogate across six clients that each hold cars of a single body type, and we compare three spectral optimizers, which orthogonalize the update of each weight matrix (FedMuon and two methods we propose, FedMARS-M and FedOLion), with three non-spectral ones (FedAvg, SCAFFOLD-Adam and FedLion), all tuned with the same protocol. FedMuon and FedMARS-M reach a drag error within 2% of centralized training with Muon, using two to four local epochs per round. The non-spectral methods perform best with sixteen local epochs, the largest number we tested, and still have a 17 to 37% higher drag error than FedMARS-M. item.title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦优化局部更新的代价：更快走向错误答案的偏差分析

Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[μ,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $χ\in[1,L/μ]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-μχ)/(2μL\sqrtχ)$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.

item.title: Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R

DISCO is a recent internal cluster validity index for density-based clustering that, unlike earlier indices, also evaluates the quality of noise labels. The discoCVI package makes DISCO available in R. This article describes the design of the package and a typical workflow, in which DISCO is used to compare clusterings and to choose the parameters of HDBSCAN without ground truth, followed by the implementation introduced in version 0.2.0. DISCO is defined through density-connectivity distances between all pairs of points, so direct implementations store several n-by-n matrices. We show that every quantity DISCO needs can be read off the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree, so that the index can be computed exactly with memory that grows linearly with the number of points, while the running time remains quadratic as in the original definition. The implementation is tested against the previous version, agrees with the original Python implementation to within $3 \times 10^{-13}$, and corrects the score of singleton clusters to match the published definition. In benchmarks, discoCVI is 23 to 138 times faster than its previous version for 500 to 4,…

item.title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

混合图神经网络代理：有限元分析的逐元素股骨应力预测

Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. item.title: Dissecting an Unexplored SASS Control-Code Field: Barrier Exemption and Programmable Warp Priority
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 NVIDIA SASS 指令里一个控制码字段在 cuBLAS/cuDNN 等闭源库中出现超 50 万次，但 nvcc 编译用户程序从不发出，其作用一直未知。

方法 首个跨 Volta 到 Blackwell 的系统性研究：指令级微基准揭示该字段控制两个独立硬件机制——屏障豁免（EXEMPT，允许被屏障阻塞的指令提前发出）与可编程 warp 优先级（START/TILE/END 三级）；并实现后编译二进制优化器，不改源码与编译器直接改写二进制。

关键数字 6 张 GPU（4 代架构）上代表性 kernel 提速最高 31.9%；llama.cpp 和 vLLM 生产 kernel 提速最高 5.4%，端到端 LLM 推理提速最高 3.6%。

为什么值得看 挖出 NVIDIA 隐藏硬件机制且可无侵入优化二进制，对 GPU kernel 极致优化很有价值。

item.title: Density Feedback Control for Transferability of Generative Sparse Adversarial Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Density Feedback Control for Transferability of Generative Sparse Adversarial Attacks

Generator-based sparse adversarial attacks train encoder--decoder networks to produce transferable sparse perturbations for black-box robustness evaluation. Their perturbation density, however, is set only indirectly by a fixed sparsity coefficient whose mapping to density is unknown and shifts during training, so reaching a target density requires re-tuning; this fixed pressure also yields little transferability gain once density reduction begins. We propose Density Feedback Control (DFC), which tightens or relaxes this coefficient at the end of each epoch according to the gap between the observed hard-mask density and the target, without changing the generator architecture or loss. At a 10\% target density, DFC brings the mean density of three base attacks within one percentage point of the target in a single run and improves the transfer attack success rate (ASR) of two of them on CNN and Transformer targets, including under per-image $\ell_0$ budgets, while perturbing fewer pixels. Tracing GPG's training, we observe that as DFC relaxes the coefficient, the transfer ASR recovers with the density and overtakes the fixed-coefficient baseline with fewer pixels. item.title: DS3M: Deep structured state space models for nonlinear system identification on modern hardware
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

DS3M: Deep structured state space models for nonlinear system identification on modern hardware

Neural state-space identification learns dynamical models from measured inputs and outputs. SUBNET combines this task with an encoder that estimates initial states from short measurement histories. Its continuous-time version requires many successive neural-network evaluations during numerical integration, resulting in slow training speed which is a major limitation for practical use cases. We propose deep structured state space models (DS3M), which combine compact nonlinear dynamical components in parallel and in series. Custom GPU kernels implemented with Triton reduce the launch and memory overhead of their sequential evaluation. We explain this construction, describe a port-Hamiltonian variant, and present various benchmark comparisons of accuracy and training time.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

沟通式 on-policy 蒸馏：通过通信蒸馏黑盒教师能力（长程任务）

On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

任务感知融合：多模态材料语言模型的表示选择

Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. item.title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Cap-and-Track：跨漂移容量优化 LLM 推理请求分发

A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. It served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate precursor, though lower-priority work waited longer at backfill peaks. In steady-capacity real-engine replay, Track ran within 1% of the goodput of a fixed rate tuned above measured capacity, with about a quarter of that rate's re…

item.title: CAIMS: Scalable Cross-Array In-Memory Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：内存搜索（IMS）在 CAM 阵列内原位做 top-k 相似性搜索、低延迟高能效，但单阵列容量不足，跨阵列部署时如何把局部二值匹配准确高效地归约为全局 top-k 尚无解。

方法：CAIMS 跨阵列 IMS 框架，与存储介质和应用无关：复用阈值匹配功能，离线+在线参数选择把缺乏全局可比相似度信息的局部二值结果转为全局粗粒度分数；分层归约，只传输选择结果与必要控制信号。

关键数字：3D NAND Flash 模型上跑 RAG 检索阶段，吞吐相对服务器级 CPU 基线最高提升 22.3×、相对先前 3D NAND 加速器 10.1×；能效分别提升 426.6×/23.7×，精度相当。

为什么值得看：可扩展跨阵列内存搜索，RAG 场景能效收益两个数量级。

item.title: Bottom-Up FPGA Reconfigurable Accelerator Overlay Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：可编程 FPGA overlay 免重综合运行新负载，但模板化生成浪费开关与链路、时钟频率低。

方法：从负载数据流图自底向上生长 overlay：按结构相似度聚类负载、用谱描述符排序共享槽，只添加负载缺失的单元与链路；全部构建在原生硬块上（流水寄存器、双口存储、double-pumped DSP），超宽数据类型用固定功能引擎。

关键数字：AMD VCK5000 上 17 个负载运行于 250–400 MHz（OverGen 仅 35–50 MHz）；几何平均快 9.52–10.33×（最高 36.97×），FPGA 用量少 19.4–22.1×，板级能耗估计少 9.67–10.51×。

为什么值得看：overlay 生成范式转向负载驱动，频率与资源效率数量级提升。

item.title: Berth: SLO-Preserving GPU Sharing Without New Preemption
item.description:

item.title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

仅通过查询审计黑盒临床预测模型的盲测

Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check agai…

item.title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Atomic MathReasoner：数学 LLM 原子推理技能的实例级组合

Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. It evaluates the preference of each prototype using the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, filters ambiguous assignments through a confidence margin, and distills the resulting pseudo-labels into a lightweight router. During inference, the router selects an appropriate composition prototype for each problem, enabling problem-specific utilization of atomic skills without costly…

item.title: Accelerating Distributed Digital Ising Machines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

分布式数字 Ising 机的加速：面向组合优化与概率采样的规模扩展

Ising machines, dedicated accelerators built around the dynamics of Ising-like spin models, have emerged as a leading platform for combinatorial optimization and probabilistic sampling. The problems that motivate them require millions of spins, far beyond the on-chip capacity of any single device, so a practical Ising machine must distribute its computation across many devices. Prior work reports throughput at a single operating point, leaving the binding resource unidentified and platform crossovers measurable only by experiment; no calibrated cross-platform cost model of distributed Ising machines has been reported, nor have systematic techniques to accelerate their Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) workloads. This work presents a calibrated cost model that decomposes digital Ising sweep time into compute, memory, synchronization, and inter-device communication terms, validated with 4.8% mean error across three GPU generations, FPGA and ASIC up to 1 million spins. item.title: A Runtime System for Mitigating Crossbar Port Contention on SM-Partitioned GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SM 分区 GPU 上缓解 crossbar 端口争用的运行时系统

To avoid scheduling delays when running concurrent workloads on a GPU, Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) partitioning mechanisms such as CUDA Green Contexts restrict each workload to separate SMs. Despite this partitioning, concurrent workloads still significantly slow down latency-critical workloads, which recent studies attribute to shared L2 cache and memory contention. However, contention also occurs at the crossbar ports connecting each Graphics Processing Cluster (GPC) of SMs to the L2 cache, as all SMs in a GPC share one port. Green Contexts spread workloads across GPCs, placing concurrent workloads in the same GPCs and forcing latency-critical memory requests to queue behind background requests. Packing workloads into separate GPCs avoids this contention, but forces latency-critical memory requests through fewer ports, limiting memory bandwidth. Consequently, neither spreading nor packing is always faster across workloads and GPUs. Based on these observations, we present GPCPlace, a runtime system that dynamically selects between spreading and packing by profiling workloads on the target GPU to estimate both slowdowns, and hooks kernel launches in the CUDA driver to set SM mask…

item.title: A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models

Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recall frontier on ambiguous text-to-SQL (Ambrosia), and on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), it raises diversity at about the same pass@$K$.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Fast, Programmable GPU-to-CPU Invocation Layer for GPU-Initiated Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 设备发起通信的主流做法（GPUDirect Async）把传输控制放 GPU 线程，反向 offload 到 host 代理线程被视为慢速回退路径。

方法 KIWI 论证反向 offload 可超越 GDA、应成为一等通信路径，并把它暴露为可编程接口，让用户定义负载特定的通信操作；KIWI-P2P（SHMEM 类库）与 KIWI-EP（MoE 分发/合并内核重构）基于它构建。

关键数字 亚微秒级单程 device-to-host 延迟、每秒数亿次操作；AMD GPU 上专家并行通信延迟最多降 2.3×，vLLM 每 token 输出时间最多降 29%。

为什么值得看 扭转"反向 offload 是次选"的既有认知，可编程接口对 MoE 等负载友好，源码已开源。

item.title: blaris: Windowless Random-Access LZSS for Constrained Microcontrollers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：嵌入式 LZ77 解压器（heatshrink、tamp）需要 RAM 滑动窗口，内存占用与压缩率耦合，且随机访问读延迟高。

方法：blaris 轻量无窗口 LZSS 解压器，面向受限微控制器的 XIP 随机访问：把 token 划分为双向可遍历流并设 2 的幂检查点，直接在压缩载荷内解析反向引用，不分配 RAM 窗口；面向 compress-on-host/decompress-on-device 工作流，假设可信构建期载荷，省略运行时错误与边界检查。

关键数字：压缩率与高窗口 heatshrink/tamp 配置相当；RV32IMC 上仅需 548-784 B Flash、104-112 B 总 RAM；小片随机读比比例匹配的块索引 heatshrink/tamp 快数量级。

为什么值得看：把解压器的内存占用与压缩率解耦，为闪存直接执行场景提供极低资源开销的随机访问解压。

item.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产 LLM 长上下文用稀疏注意力，但 serving 仍须保留完整 KV 历史，GPU HBM 容量限制并发；现有 KV offload 到 host 内存受 PCIe 带宽与 host 容量双重限制。

方法：分析发现即便有 scale-up 内存池，解码吞吐仍被 HBM 容量钳制——热 KV 缓冲与常驻索引器 key 缓存（K-index）占用大量 HBM 且访问模式不同；XM-Sparse 首个基于 scale-up 内存扩展的稀疏注意力 offload 系统：动态 KV 条目用 TMA 检索与注意力做 tile 级流水线融合隐藏延迟，可预测 K-index 访问用 SM 高效 GPU-initiated DMA 预取并避开解码关键路径。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.3 + 模拟 scale-up 内存池：解码吞吐比 PCIe 的 ECHO 高 4.98×、比 HiSparse 高 4.52×，同平台比 naive 集成高 1.34×，覆盖 16K-1M 上下文。

为什么值得看：首个面向 scale-up 内存池的稀疏注意力 offload 系统，按两类缓存的访问模式分别定制 I/O 机制。

item.title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

On-policy 蒸馏目标的理论分析：token 粒度/顺序/速度的选择

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even…

item.title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

LoRA 子空间方向重要性的机制分析：few-shot 幅度原则的 regime 依赖

We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful.
